$comment: Side-quest generator tables (spec §7.4). The generator (A108) combines a quest type, a site, an antagonist, a complication, a twist and a reward into a normal adventure (ADVENTURE_FORMAT.md). `threads` are woven-in hooks from data/adventures/DESIGN.md §14: when their condition holds, the generator prefers them. {placeholders} are filled by the generator. Monster ids are SRD 5.2.1; location ids and regions come from data/world/lore.json. Each quest type lists its `approaches` (fight/sneak/talk/trick/bribe/skill; success tags from approachTags in the generator) and `outcomes` (the choice once the job is resolved: reward multipliers, whether the thread write-back applies, and `tags` → companion approval via `approvalTags`). Bribes cost rewards.bribePerLevel gp × level.

questTypes.name: Hunt a fugitive
questTypes.goal: Track down {antagonist} and bring them to justice

approaches.label: Take {antagonist} by surprise while they rest
approaches.success: You are on {antagonist} before a hand reaches for a weapon.

approaches.label: Talk {antagonist} into giving up
approaches.success: {antagonist} hears you out and lays down their arms.

approaches.label: Lure {antagonist} out with a forged message
approaches.success: {antagonist} walks straight into your hands.

approaches.label: Pay one of {antagonist}'s hangers-on to hand them over
approaches.success: Coin changes hands; that night {antagonist} is delivered bound and gagged.

outcomes.label: Take {antagonist} back in chains
outcomes.text: {antagonist} is bound for the road back.

outcomes.label: Put an end to {antagonist} here
outcomes.text: It is over quickly. {antagonist} will run no more.

outcomes.label: Let {antagonist} go, on their word to leave for good
outcomes.text: {antagonist} stares, then vanishes into the dark without a word.

approaches.label: Creep in and strike the leader first
approaches.success: The leader falls before it wakes; the rest scatter in panic.

approaches.label: Smoke them out into a trap at the entrance
approaches.success: Smoke and a snare do the work of a dozen blades.

outcomes.label: Collapse the entrance so nothing nests here again
outcomes.claim: Tell {patron} the place is cleared for good
outcomes.text: Stone and timber come down with a roar. Nothing will nest here again.

outcomes.label: Let the survivors scatter into the wilds
outcomes.claim: Tell {patron} the lair is empty now
outcomes.text: The last of them slink off into the wilds, far from any farm.

approaches.label: Storm in and free the captive
Slip in and free the captive quietly
approaches.success: Ropes cut, a hand over a mouth, and you are both out before anyone looks up.

approaches.label: Negotiate the {relative}'s release
approaches.success: After a long, tense talk the captors let the {relative} walk free.

approaches.label: Pay the ransom
approaches.success: The captors count the coin twice and shove the {relative} towards you.

outcomes.label: Bring the {relative} home
outcomes.text: The {relative} clings to you the whole way back.

outcomes.label: The {relative} begs not to go back: help them start over elsewhere
outcomes.claim: Tell {patron} you could not find the {relative}
outcomes.text: You point the {relative} to a safer road. They thank you in a whisper and are gone.

approaches.label: Search {site} for the {heirloom}
approaches.success: Under rubble and rot you find the {heirloom}.

approaches.label: Sneak past whatever lairs there
approaches.success: You slip past the lair unheard and take the {heirloom}.

approaches.label: Draw the guardians off with a decoy
approaches.success: A rattle of stones and a scrap of meat draw them away; the {heirloom} is yours.

outcomes.label: Keep the {heirloom} safe for {patron}
outcomes.text: You wrap the {heirloom} carefully for the road.

outcomes.label: Keep the {heirloom} and sell it on the quiet
outcomes.text: A fence in the next town will pay well and ask nothing.

approaches.label: Take a hidden trail around the danger
approaches.success: The old trail is overgrown but empty; {destination} comes into view unmolested.

approaches.label: Talk your way past the men blocking the road
approaches.success: A few calm words and a steady look, and they step aside.

approaches.label: Pay the road toll they demand
approaches.success: They pocket the toll and wave you through.

outcomes.label: Demand double pay before the last mile
outcomes.text: {patron} pays with shaking hands and a bitter look.

approaches.label: Search for clues
approaches.success: A torn receipt and a muddy boot print point to {antagonist}.

approaches.label: Question the locals
approaches.success: One nervous answer too many, and the trail leads to {antagonist}.

approaches.label: Shadow the likeliest suspect
approaches.success: You follow them to a back room and hear {antagonist} give the orders.

approaches.label: Set a trap with false gossip
approaches.success: Your rumour flushes out {antagonist}, caught in the act.

outcomes.label: Expose {antagonist} in front of everyone
outcomes.text: The whole street hears what {antagonist} did.

outcomes.label: Keep quiet, for a price paid by {antagonist}
outcomes.text: {antagonist} pays for your silence, and will pay again.

approaches.label: Take the fast road
approaches.success: You find the quickest way and keep to it.

approaches.label: Ride through the night
approaches.success: Bone-tired, you make it before dawn.

approaches.label: Slip past the watchers of {antagonist}
approaches.success: The watchers never see you pass.

approaches.label: Hire a fresh horse at every inn
approaches.success: Fresh horses and good roads: you arrive with time to spare.

outcomes.label: Sell {parcel} to {antagonist}, who pays far more
outcomes.claim: Tell {patron} you were robbed on the road
outcomes.text: {antagonist} pays well. Someone in {destination} will wait in vain.

approaches.label: Broker a fair compromise
approaches.success: Grudgingly, both sides shake hands on it.

approaches.label: Find out what they both really want
approaches.success: Beneath the shouting it is about pride, and pride can be settled.

approaches.label: Bluff them both into agreeing
approaches.success: Each thinks the other gave way first. Neither ever learns the truth.

approaches.label: Smooth things over with coin
approaches.success: A purse on each side of the table makes the words come easier.

outcomes.label: Put the settlement in writing, fair to both
outcomes.text: Both sides sign. It is fair, and both hate it a little.

outcomes.label: Tilt the settlement in favour of {patron}
outcomes.claim: Tell {patron} you won them the better deal

outcomes.label: Take {rival}'s purse and tilt the deal their way
outcomes.claim: Tell {patron} it was the best you could do

sites.name: a bandit camp in the hills
sites.seed: Tents and a smoky firepit behind a screen of thorn bushes; a lookout dozes on a boulder.

sites.name: a ruined watchtower
sites.seed: A cracked tower of grey stone, its stair half-collapsed and its roof open to the sky.

sites.name: an abandoned mine
sites.seed: Rotting timber props hold up a low tunnel; old rails vanish into the dark.

sites.name: a quiet forest glade
sites.seed: Sunlight slants through oaks onto a mossy glade; something has flattened the ferns.

sites.name: a den under a fallen oak
sites.seed: Gnawed bones litter the ground before a dark hollow under the roots.

sites.name: a stilt-shack in the fen
sites.seed: A shack on rotting stilts above black water, lit by a single guttering candle.

sites.name: a half-drowned crypt
sites.seed: Stone steps lead down into ankle-deep water; carved names on the walls are worn smooth.

sites.name: a hollow in the deep bog
sites.seed: Reeds tower overhead; the ground quakes underfoot and bubbles break the surface.

sites.name: the old fen causeway
sites.seed: A raised causeway of sunken logs winds between pools of fog.

sites.name: a tidal sea cave
sites.seed: Waves boom in a cave mouth that floods at high tide; barnacled crates are stacked on a ledge.

sites.name: a smugglers' cove
sites.seed: A crescent beach hidden by cliffs, a rowboat pulled up among the rocks.

sites.name: a beached shipwreck
sites.seed: The ribs of a great ship lie on the sand, its hold gaping and dark.

sites.name: a vine-choked island ruin
sites.seed: Parrots screech above stone steps swallowed by vines and roots.

sites.name: the coast road
sites.seed: A windswept road along the cliffs, gulls wheeling below.

sites.name: the king's road
sites.seed: A paved road lined with milestones, busy with carts by day.

sites.name: the market and its back alleys
sites.seed: Stalls, gossip and narrow alleys where people speak in low voices.

complications.text: {antagonist} expected company and set an ambush.
It has to be done within a day, or it will be too late.
Another band of adventurers is after the same prize.
A storm rolls in as you arrive, making every step harder.
The way in is barred and watched.
An innocent is caught in the middle and must not be harmed.

twists.text: {patron} lied about why they wanted this done.
{antagonist} had a good reason for what they did.
{antagonist} had been fleeing something far worse.
You find the seven-tooth sigil of the Hollow Choir scratched nearby.
